senses.gloss: (b. h.) to move in the air, to soar. [Yalk. Ps. 676 שהוא נפה, read: שהיא צפה, v. צוּף.]

units: <cite ref="Menachot 61b:1">Men. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>כהן מניח … ומֵנִיף</he> the priest places his hand under those of the owner of the offering and waves.

<cite ref="Menachot 61b">Ib.</cite> <he>אין העכ״ום מְנִיפִין</he> gentiles are not permitted to wave their offerings; <he>אין הנשים מְנִיפוֹת</he> women are not permitted &c. Ib.ᵃ <he>וכול יָנִיף ויחזור ויניף</he> I might think that he must wave twice.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:1">Snh. VI, 1</cite> <he>מֵנִיף בסודרין</he> gave the signal by waving a cloth; <cite ref="Sukkah 51b">Succ. 51ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 41:1">Pesik. R. s. 41</cite> (ref. to <he>יפה נוף</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 48:3">Ps. XLVIII, 3</cite>) <he>היפה שהיא עתידה להָנִיף את וכ׳</he> the beautiful one (Israel) who is destined to swing (rule) the nations; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 755:2">Yalk. Ps. 755</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 417:3">Yalk. Ex. 417</cite> <he>שהיא מְנִיפָה לאו״ה</he> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 30:28">Is. XXX, 28</cite>); a. fr.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:12">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>הָנִיפִי עלי</he>, v. <cite ref="M01788"><he>מְנִיפָא</he></cite>. Y. Yoma I, 38ᶜ <he>ומניפין לרבוניהם</he> and fan their masters. Pesik. R. l. c.; Yalk. Ps. l. c. <he>והכל מניפין עליה</he> and all fan her (are subservient to her); a. e.

senses.gloss: to swing, fan. Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ והיתה רוח … ומְנַפְנֶפֶת בו and the northern wind blew and set the harp swinging. Yalk. Ps. l. c. שיוצא ומְנַפְנֵף את דגניה (not רגליה) (the dew) which goes forth and makes her grain in the ear wave (bend with its weight); Pesik. R. l. c. ומְנַפֵּף את הדגנים. Ohol. VIII, 5 טלית המְנַפְנֶפֶת a sheet suspended as a banner (cmp. מַפָּה).

units: <cite ref="Yevamot 63a">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> (addressing the ears in the field, in Chald. dict.) <he>אֵי במנפה תִתְנוֹפְפִי</he> Ar., eh! thou desirest to be winnowed with the fan; [oth. vers. in Ar.: <he>כמנפה תתנופפי</he> (not <he>במנ׳</he>) thou swingest thyself like a swing, v. infra]; ed. v. <cite ref="N00388">next w.</cite>

senses.gloss: to swing one’s self; to soar; to be proud.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 24b:17">Ab. Zar. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>הִתְנוֹפְפִי וכ׳</he> rise (O Ark) in the &c., v. <cite ref="E00149"><he>הָדָר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 54">Gen. R. s. 54</cite>. Yeb. l. c., v. supra.
